goal: Prepare the first expansion wave for CropMedic crop identification and crop-specific disease models.

primary_source.name: Multi-Class Soybean Leaf Disease Dataset: Healthy and Diseased Leaf Images for Machine Learning
primary_source.capture: real-time field images under natural conditions

external_validation_source.name: Auburn Soybean Disease Image Dataset (ASDID)
external_validation_source.notes: Large dataset; do not mix into the pilot training set before external evaluation.

primary_source.name: High-Resolution Dataset of Common Bean Leaf Diseases in Bangladesh
primary_source.capture: natural-daylight mobile-phone images of common bean leaves collected from fields
primary_source.notes: Images use a clean A4 background, so keep truly in-field smartphone images for external validation.

deprecated_source.name: Makerere AI Lab / NaCRRI Beans dataset
deprecated_source.notes: Good Ugandan field smartphone dataset, but the published TFDS storage.googleapis.com/ibeans URLs currently return HTTP 403 and must not block Batch 1.

external_validation_source.name: A Labeled Dataset of Healthy and Diseased Common Beans from Tanzania
external_validation_source.capture: multi-season smartphone field images reviewed by extension officers and plant pathologists
external_validation_source.notes: Very large dataset. Reserve a geographically separate holdout before any later training use.

primary_source.name: Wheat Leaf Dataset
primary_source.capture: real wheat farm in Ethiopia, uncontrolled environment, pathologist-sorted

secondary_source.name: Disease Dataset of Wheat: Original, Augmented, and Balanced for Deep Learning
secondary_source.notes: Use original images only for evaluation/training splits; do not place augmented derivatives across train and test.

primary_source.name: Sorghum Disease Image Dataset
primary_source.notes: Several classes affect heads/grain rather than only leaves. CropMedic should prompt for the affected plant part, not force a leaf-only workflow.

candidate_source.name: Tobacco leaf disease segmentation dataset referenced by MD-Unet
candidate_source.notes: Publicly referenced by the paper, but CropMedic must verify the dataset license and class definitions before using it for training. Do not ingest automatically.

crop_recognition_source.name: Tobacco and Weed Detection Dataset
crop_recognition_source.capture: smartphone field images of tobacco and weeds
crop_recognition_source.notes: Useful for plant-level crop recognition/OOD work, not a disease classifier.
